findings.description: Nit: This remediation switches per-model `estimated_fraction` in `ledger._aggregate_by_model` to an entry-count ratio (`estimated_counts / entry_counts`, with tests now expecting `0.5`), but `contracts/openapi/v1.yaml` still documents `UsageAggregate.by_model.estimated_fraction` as "Share of spend from estimated token counts". Top-level `estimated_fraction` already says entry share, so the by-model OpenAPI description is now stale relative to the code this diff ships.
findings.resolution: Update the by_model `estimated_fraction` OpenAPI description to "Share of included entries with estimated token counts" (matching the top-level field and the new aggregator), or regenerate/sync any derived docs from that contract.
findings.existing_code: estimated_fraction: {type: number, default: 0, description: Share of spend from estimated token counts}

findings.description: Nit: Replacing `delete_entry` with `set_availability(..., available=False)` retains superseded local catalog rows, and `probe_all` still loads them via `list_entries(endpoint_kind="local")` (default `include_unavailable=True`). Each retained placeholder/old model is re-probed every tick: on success it re-upserts the current reported id and marks itself unavailable again. One placeholder is a permanent +1 request per endpoint; repeated model-id changes accumulate unbounded probe fan-out while routing correctly ignores those rows.
findings.resolution: Either (a) probe unavailable rows only when no other available row shares the same `(vendor, base_url)`, or (b) keep the placeholder unavailable for posterior retention but delete/skip non-placeholder predecessors once the discovered model row exists.
findings.existing_code:
await self._catalog.set_availability(
                    vendor,
                    model,
                    "local",
                    available=False,
                    p50_latency_ms=None,
                )

findings.description: none: Round-2 confirmed defects are closed in this remediation: `db_postgres.query` now `_decode_query_value`s on eq/gt/gte/lte/in before coercion (with a postgres filter decode test), and `LedgerService.usage_summary` emits `exploration_entries` consumed by `_current_exploration_budget` (asserted in `test_usage_summary_aggregates_by_model_and_exploration_spend`). Related resilience extras (skip ledger when exploration is off; fail closed with `budget_state.status=unavailable`) and MCP 422 parity also look coherent; related unit tests in this packet passed locally.
